scope.summary: This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for tricyclazole, technical, which is used as an active ingredient in the formulation of agricultural fungicides (primarily to control rice blast disease caused by Magnaporthe oryzae).

certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary/Mandatory under the Insecticides Act. Manufacturers are encouraged to apply for the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) to print on product containers as a certified assurance of quality. Additionally, all packaging, labeling, and distribution of technical-grade tricyclazole must strictly comply with statutory registrations and warning declarations mandated under the Insecticides Act, 1968 and Rules framed thereunder.

requirements.detail: Mandates that the tricyclazole content shall be a minimum of 95.0 percent by mass, determined by Gas Chromatography (GLC) using internal standard technique.
Restricts moisture content to a maximum of 0.5 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 4 of IS 6940.
Restricts free acidity (calculated as H2SO4) to a maximum of 0.5 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 11.3.2 of IS 6940.
Limits material insoluble in acetone to a maximum of 0.5 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 9 of IS 6940.

Technical tricyclazole must be securely packed in containers satisfying the general requirements of IS 8190 (Part 1) for solid technical pesticides. Sampling of the technical material shall be carried out as prescribed in IS 10946.

Each container must legibly and indelibly bear: the name of the material, manufacturer's name and address, batch number, date of manufacture, date of expiry, net quantity, nominal tricyclazole content (percent m/m), and standard cautionary notices worded in accordance with the Insecticides Act, 1968.

Specifies resolving the tricyclazole peak and internal standard using a gas chromatograph (GLC) equipped with a flame ionization detector (FID) coupled to a PC-based data system or printer-plotter-cum-integrator to accurately calculate active ingredient content.

Any observed or calculated test or analysis value expressing purity, moisture, acidity, or insolubles must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be identical to the specified value in the standard.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 15982 : 2013 is the national Indian Standard specification establishing technical requirements, sampling protocols, and analytical methods for tricyclazole, technical. Prepared by the FAD 1 Sectional Committee, this standard regulates the chemical quality of this active fungicidal ingredient, which is widely utilized in crop protection formulations to control rice blast disease (Magnaporthe oryzae). It mandates a minimum purity (tricyclazole content) of 95.0% by mass, limits moisture to 0.5%, acidity to 0.5%, and acetone insolubles to 0.5%. It outlines a precise Gas Chromatography (GLC) test using an internal standard technique to verify chemical purity, ensuring safety and environmental compliance under the statutory framework of the Insecticides Act, 1968.
